title: UPSSSC Assistant Statistical Officer ASO Admit Card 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
vacancyDetails: Admit card for UPSSSC Assistant Statistical Officer written examination
qualification: As per UPSSSC ASO advertisement (Statistics/Mathematics related graduation as notified)
ageLimit: As per UPSSSC rules for the advertisement
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Document Verification / further stages as notified
documentsRequired: UPSSSC registration credentials; printed admit card; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open Admit Card / Download section for Assistant Statistical Officer
3. Login with registration details
4. Download and print admit card
5. Follow exam date and centre instructions
shortDescription: UPSSSC Assistant Statistical Officer Admit Card 2026 – download hall ticket from upsssc.gov.in when link is active for the written exam.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) issues admit cards for the Assistant Statistical Officer examination on its official portal.

Candidates should regularly check upsssc.gov.in for the latest admit card notice, exam city and exam date updates. Carry a printed hall ticket and original photo identity proof to the examination centre.
